ad_title_or_description: TV ad on Talarico and gender surgeries for kids

ad_title_or_description: Aldaco ad on Brown and transgender surgery
claim: Brown supports sex changes for minors; the woman featured isn't from Ohio, had her surgery at 19, and Ohio already bans such procedures for minors.

ad_title_or_description: Ad saying Brown supports 'forcing childhood sex change surgery'

ad_title_or_description: Ad on Husted, data centers and tax breaks
